requirements.title: Editable SDLC is data, not a fixed stage array
requirements.scenario: Given the shipped SDLC profile, insert a privacy review, split implementation into substeps and reorder permitted work in diagram and form; publish and execute without editing application code.
checks: same semantic digest in both editors
new enabled run uses new digest

requirements.title: Diagram and structured editor are equivalent
requirements.scenario: Given keyboard-only and pointer users, every supported insertion, binding, branch, loop and criterion edit round-trips between outline/form/diagram after reload with undo and conflict recovery.

requirements.title: Versioned typed workflow contract
requirements.scenario: Given human, agent, action, evaluation, choice, parallel, repeat, subprocess and wait nodes, registry/schema validation rejects unknown actions, invalid ports and incompatible versions at exact field paths.

requirements.title: Bounded loops and shared nested budgets
requirements.scenario: Given a repair loop capped at three iterations and a shared budget, repeated failure exhausts at three with human escalation; nesting/fan-out/retry cannot reset counters or multiply reserved funds.

requirements.title: Branches parallel joins and subprocesses
requirements.scenario: Given parallel security/performance evaluation and conditional review, runtime and simulation select identical next nodes; ambiguous choice, token mismatch or missing mandatory path blocks publication.
checks: unreachable or bypassed required check blocked

requirements.title: Safe criteria and unknown semantics
requirements.scenario: Given typed all/any/not criteria over evidence and units, missing evidence yields unknown and protects effects; script/network injection, incompatible units and stale evaluation cannot authorize.

requirements.title: Action registry is not new authority
requirements.scenario: Given a configured action or agent adapter, parameter changes respect the registered schema, current grants, data/target scope and independent checks; renamed nodes cannot bypass mandatory policy.

requirements.title: Immutable versions inheritance and enablement
requirements.scenario: Given a tenant override of a pinned template, template upgrade produces a reviewed three-way diff; layout-only edits do not invalidate semantics and publication does not imply enabled execution.

requirements.title: Explicit safe active-run migration
requirements.scenario: Given a paused v1 run and edited v2 profile, approved compatible mapping creates a fenced linked successor; unknown external effect, missing input or incompatible state blocks transfer.
checks: old approvals not inherited as current

requirements.title: Durable runtime bridge and replay
requirements.scenario: Given crashes after start intent, domain result and provider acceptance, Temporal bridge reconciles identical run/effect IDs; runtime history replay and domain outbox cannot duplicate accepted effects.

requirements.title: Timers events and correlated human decisions
requirements.scenario: Given timezone/DST/misfire waits and duplicated or wrong-run decision messages, exactly the eligible logical trigger resumes; revocation and expiry deny stale human authority.
checks: wrong node or iteration decision rejected

requirements.title: Failure and compensation are separate effects
requirements.scenario: Given partial parallel effects and compensation timeout, record completed/unknown operations and recovery-pending until independent provider evidence; compensation requires current authority.

requirements.title: Simulation is useful but cannot impersonate execution
requirements.scenario: Given pass/fail/unknown/timeout/denial/loop-exhaustion fixtures, simulation previews eligible paths without effects; the real runtime agrees on recorded inputs and UI labels simulations explicitly.

requirements.title: Portable loss-aware workflow interchange
requirements.scenario: Given OrgWard profile export/import and supported BPMN mapping, definitions and provenance round-trip; unsupported constructs or missing extensions report exact loss and cannot activate silently.
checks: same manifest replay no duplicate activation

requirements.title: Customer-owned runtime installation and recovery
requirements.scenario: Given pinned self-host release, independently install, upgrade interpreter/runtime and restore both domain and orchestration state; old workers are fenced, histories replay and no accepted effect repeats.
checks: no hidden cloud dependency or unapproved fallback

requirements.title: Changed workflow works end to end for real users
requirements.scenario: Given one pinned release, representative users edit SDLC in diagram and structured forms, execute versions with actual isolated model/repository/deployment adapters and prove the policy, failure and migration counterexamples.
checks: actual browser API persistence and effects evidence
no hard-coded stage rail controls eligibility
